name: influencer.read
description: One person on the roster, as influencer.list answers each.
sql:
with d as materialized (
  select distinct p.brand_id, b.org_id, h.handle
  from brandbase.posts p join brandbase.brands b on b.id = p.brand_id
  cross join lateral brandbase.post_handles(p.draft) as h(handle)
)
select brandbase.influencer_json(i.id) || jsonb_build_object('brands', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(s.brand_id order by s.brand_id) from (select l.brand_id from brandbase.influencer_brands l where l.influencer_id = i.id union select d.brand_id from d join brandbase.influencer_accounts a on a.influencer_id = i.id and a.platform = 'instagram' and a.handle = d.handle where d.org_id = i.org_id) s), '[]'::jsonb)) as result from brandbase.influencers i where i.id = :id::uuid
